sources.name: r/classactions
sources.role: Main community source. Read the sidebar and posts for newly opened claims and which listing sites people actually use.

sources.name: Top Class Actions
sources.role: Most-recommended listing site in the subreddit. Open settlements and links toward administrator pages.

sources.name: ClassAction.org
sources.role: Second site the subreddit repeatedly names for open settlements and newsletters.

sources.name: OpenClassActions
sources.role: Recommended when people want a list that calls out no-proof claims.

sources.name: ClaimDepot
sources.role: Recommended because each write-up links to the official settlement website and claim form.

sources.name: Settlement Pulse
sources.role: Cross-check for deadlines, payout ranges, and whether proof is required. Confirm every claim on the official administrator site before you file.

settlements.name: Atrium Health
settlements.classDefinition: MyAtriumHealth or MyCarolinas portal users affected by patient-data tracking pixels.

settlements.name: Xactus / Credit Plus
settlements.classDefinition: People whose consumer report was shared without proper consent between 2021 and 2026.

settlements.name: LifeStance Health
settlements.classDefinition: Patients affected by website tracking pixels on LifeStance's site.

settlements.name: Google Play
settlements.classDefinition: Consumers who bought apps or in-app items covered by the Google Play state attorneys general settlement.

settlements.name: Bayhealth
settlements.classDefinition: Website and portal users affected by Bayhealth tracking pixels.

settlements.name: Flo Health / Google
settlements.classDefinition: Flo app users covered by the Flo Health and Google privacy settlement.

settlements.name: Toyota
settlements.classDefinition: Owners or lessees of covered Toyota vehicles. This claim asks for proof of ownership or the qualifying repair.

settlements.name: Cash App
settlements.classDefinition: Cash App account holders included in the settlement class for the covered period.

settlements.name: Hyundai & Kia theft
settlements.classDefinition: Owners of covered Hyundai or Kia vehicles. Proof of ownership and, for higher amounts, proof of a qualifying loss.

settlements.name: Hyundai & Kia documented loss
settlements.classDefinition: Owners with documented theft-related losses on covered Hyundai or Kia vehicles. Receipts or insurance records are required.

settlements.name: Amazon Prime
settlements.classDefinition: Amazon customers enrolled in a covered subscription or membership during the class period.

settlements.name: Visa & Mastercard
settlements.classDefinition: Merchants that accepted Visa or Mastercard during the class period. This is a merchant claim, not a shopper claim.

settlements.name: Circle K / Gas Express
settlements.classDefinition: People notified about the Circle K or Gas Express data breach. Higher amounts need documented losses.

settlements.name: Comcast (Xfinity)
settlements.classDefinition: Xfinity customers affected by the covered data breach. Larger payments require proof of loss.
